title: The Secret
author: Rhonda Byrne
summary: Rhonda Byrne presents the law of attraction, the claim that positive thoughts bring positive results into your life. The book combines quotations and testimonials with advice on visualizing, asking and feeling grateful.
readIf: you want an upbeat, positive-thinking read about visualizing your goals.
skipIf: you want claims supported by evidence, as the central idea has no scientific backing.
